description: Convert arrays of JSON objects into proper RFC-4180 CSV with correct quoting and escaping.

faqs.a: Fields containing commas, quotes or line breaks are wrapped in double quotes, and inner quotes are doubled — exactly as RFC-4180 requires.
faqs.q: How are commas inside values handled?

faqs.a: The header is the union of all keys across every object, in order of first appearance. Missing values become empty cells.
They are serialized as compact JSON inside the cell, so arrays and nested objects survive the round trip.
faqs.q: What happens to nested objects or arrays?

howto: Paste JSON that is an array of objects.
The CSV preview builds instantly with proper quoting.
Check the row and column count.
Download the result as a .csv file.
title: JSON to CSV Converter
